query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT created_at, id FROM account_holders WHERE ((created_at, id) > ($3, $2)) AND ($2 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $1) UNION ALL (SELECT created_at, id FROM account_holders WHERE ($2 IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $1) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $1) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $4 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, p.payload as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN account_holder_events e ON i.id = e.id LEFT JOIN account_holders_forgettable_payloads p ON e.id = p.entity_id AND e.sequence = p.sequence ORDER BY i.created_at asc, i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
